description: I'm finishing the attic of my two-storey house as a bedroom and office. The only way out of the attic is down to the second floor and then down the main stair to the front door. The attic windows are small skylights. I don't want to add a dormer. What are my options?
known_facts: two storeys of travel to the exit door

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

missing_info.field: skylight opening size and height above floor
missing_info.why: whether an egress-window route is available

gold.departure: Travel of more than one storey from the attic level to an exit or egress door without the window or balcony alternatives.

should_cite.why: window alternative for units not above or below another suite

authoring.author: Batatis evaluation builder (Claude Opus 5.5)
authoring.notes: Written from the code database only; held-out judge set not consulted.
